test_zone_search_draw_zone.title: Verify a zone can be drawn on the canvas.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search > Zone - Setup & Drawing
steps.expected: Zone - Setup & Drawing page loads without errors

steps.action: Identify the Reset Search clears Zone category selection to be deleted from the list
steps.expected: Reset Search clears Zone category selection is visible and identifiable in the list

steps.action: Note the current count of items in the list
steps.expected: Current item count is recorded for later comparison

steps.action: Click the delete button or action for the target Reset Search clears Zone category selection
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog or prompt appears

steps.action: Verify the confirmation dialog displays the correct item being deleted
steps.expected: Dialog shows the name or identifier of the Reset Search clears Zone category selection

steps.action: Click Confirm/Yes/Delete to proceed with the deletion
steps.expected: Deletion is processed and a success message appears

steps.action: Verify the Reset Search clears Zone category selection no longer appears in the list
steps.expected: Reset Search clears Zone category selection is removed from the list view

steps.action: Verify the item count decreased by one
steps.expected: List count reflects the removal

steps.action: Refresh the page and confirm the deletion persisted
steps.expected: The deleted Reset Search clears Zone category selection does not reappear after refresh

test_zone_search_returns_results.title: Verify Zone search returns results after drawing and searching

steps.action: Open Search, choose the Zone category, open the drawing view for the configured camera, draw a zone and click Done.
steps.expected: The zone is accepted and the search filters are shown again.

steps.action: Pick a duration and click Search.
steps.expected: At least one Zone result appears in the result grid.

test_line_search_returns_results.title: Verify Line search returns results after drawing and searching.

steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search - Clips
steps.expected: Search - Clips page loads without errors

steps.action: Verify the initial unfiltered list or data set is displayed
steps.expected: All items are shown before applying any search or filter

steps.action: Note the total count of items before filtering
steps.expected: Initial item count is recorded

steps.action: Locate the search input field or filter controls
steps.expected: Search/filter UI is visible and accessible

steps.action: Enter the search criteria or select the filter option for search by clip name returns matching results
steps.expected: Search/filter input accepts the value

steps.action: Trigger the search or apply the filter (press Enter or click Apply)
steps.expected: The list updates to show filtered results

steps.action: Verify the results match the search/filter criteria
steps.expected: All displayed items match the applied criteria

steps.action: Verify the result count updated to reflect the filtered set
steps.expected: Item count is less than or equal to the original count

steps.action: Clear the search/filter and verify all items return
steps.expected: Clearing the filter restores the full unfiltered list
